LANG: php
```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class SourceMapController extends Controller
{
    // GET /sourcemap?css=assets/app.css&map=../../.env.map
    public function show(Request $request)
    {
        $cssPath = $request->query('css');
        $mapPath = $request->query('map');

        if (!$cssPath) {
            return response('missing css parameter', 400);
        }

        $cssContent = Storage::disk('local')->get($cssPath);

        if ($mapPath === null) {
            if (preg_match('/\/\*\s*# sourceMappingURL=(\S+)\s*\*\//', $cssContent, $m)) {
                $mapPath = $m[1];
            }
        }

        if (!$mapPath || !str_ends_with(strtolower($mapPath), '.map')) {
            return response('no source map found', 404);
        }

        $fullPath = realpath(dirname(storage_path('app/' . $cssPath)) . '/' . $mapPath);

        if (!file_exists($fullPath)) {
            return response('map file not found', 404);
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($fullPath);

        return response($content, 200)->header('Content-Type', 'application/json');
    }
}
```

1. 第 14 行：`$request->query('map')` 与第 15 行从 CSS 内容正则提取的 `sourceMappingURL` 是攻击者完全可控的外部输入（source），可传入 `../../../etc/passwd.map` 或 `..%2f..%2f.env`。
2. 第 26 行：唯一的防御是 `str_ends_with(..., '.map')` 后缀检查，攻击者只需将目标文件命名为 `.map` 结尾或利用符号链接即可绕过，等价于原漏洞中仅靠 `.map` 扩展名限制的弱防御。
3. 第 29 行：`realpath()` 只做路径规范化，不限制结果必须位于应用目录内；`../` 序列未被拒绝，目录穿越仍然成立。
4. 第 35 行：`file_get_contents($fullPath)` 直接读取任意本地文件（sink），无白名单、无基于 CSS 文件所在目录的相对路径校验（原代码中 `relative(dirname(cssFile), path)` 的防护被移除），构成 CWE-22 路径穿越/任意文件读取。

```json
{"has_vulnerability": true, "vulnerability_type": "CWE-22 Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read", "risk_level": "high", "source": "line 15: attacker-controlled map path from query param or sourceMappingURL comment in css", "sink": "line 35: file_get_contents reads the resolved path without directory confinement", "explanation": "attacker supplies a relative path with ../ sequences -> suffix check only requires .map extension and realpath does not confine to app dir -> arbitrary local file read", "fix_suggestion": "line 29: after realpath, verify the resolved path is inside storage_path('app') using str_starts_with, and reject any path containing .. before resolution"}
```
